answer_1.quote: SlideCoder ... generates Python code using the python-pptx library ... to construct each slide.
answer_1.outputs: Python code (python-pptx script) that builds an editable PPTX slide

answer_2.quote: We adopt four metrics ... (1) Global Visual Metrics, including CLIP and SSIM scores ... (2) Local Structural Metrics ... (3) Execution ... (4) Overall Score ...

answer_4.quote: Four doctoral students were recruited as annotators, each assigned 50 slides to assess. The annotators were instructed to score each slide from the perspective of three dimensions: the number of shapes, the diversity of shape types, and the level of element coverage.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each slide on number of shapes, diversity of shape types, and element coverage ratio.
